combat_history.event: YJ-12B coastal batteries assessed as deployed to South China Sea features.
combat_history.significance: Extended a supersonic anti-ship threat over contested sea lanes.

modernization.description: Air, ship and coastal variants fielded across PLA services.
modernization.impact: Saturates a target area with simultaneous supersonic threats.

vulnerabilities.description: High-altitude cruise and launch are detectable before the terminal sprint.
vulnerabilities.context: Networked air defence with early warning can cue interceptors.
vulnerabilities.mitigation: Sea-skimming terminal phase and saturation salvos.

vulnerabilities.description: Supersonic flight burns energy, limiting range versus subsonic missiles.
vulnerabilities.context: Shorter reach than the subsonic YJ-18/Tomahawk class.
vulnerabilities.mitigation: Air-launch from H-6 extends stand-off range.

operational_patterns.typical_deployment: Saturation anti-ship strikes from bombers, ships and coastal batteries against surface task groups.
operational_patterns.typical_task_group: Air-launched from H-6 under fighter and AEW&C cover; coastal and ship batteries layered.

peer_comparisons.key_differences: YJ-18 cruises subsonic for range then sprints supersonic in the terminal phase; YJ-12 is supersonic throughout but shorter-ranged.
peer_comparisons.video_angle: China's two anti-ship cruise missiles compared.

peer_comparisons.key_differences: Russian supersonic/hypersonic ASCMs with similar high-speed terminal philosophy.
peer_comparisons.video_angle: Supersonic anti-ship missiles East vs West.

peer_comparisons.key_differences: LRASM is subsonic and stealthy with autonomous targeting — survivability over speed.
peer_comparisons.video_angle: Speed vs stealth in killing ships.

doctrine.role: Supersonic anti-ship cruise missile to overwhelm fleet defences with speed from air, sea and shore.
doctrine.employment: Sea-skimming Mach 3–4 terminal sprint, launched in saturation salvos from multiple domains.
doctrine.design_philosophy: Speed to compress the defender's reaction window to seconds.
doctrine.threat_context: The high-speed cruise half of China's anti-ship complex alongside ballistic ASBMs.
doctrine.comparison_frame: Read against the subsonic-but-longer YJ-18 and the stealthy LRASM.

images.title: PLANAF H-6J 20220518 - 1.jpg
images.description:
令和４年５月１８日（水）午前、中国軍用機Ｈ－６爆撃機２機が東シナ海方面から飛来し、沖縄本島と宮古島との間を通過して太平洋に至り、太平洋上で旋回後、反転し、再び沖縄本島と宮古島との間を通過し、東シナ海に至ったことを確認した。
これに対し、航空自衛隊の南西航空方面隊の戦闘機を緊急発進させるなど、継続的に監視を行った。
